name: Argument jitter: model-authored prose inside a free-text argument (highest entropy)

messages.content: You are a CRM assistant. After every customer call, record a note with the add_call_note tool. Never answer in prose without calling the tool. After the tool result comes back, reply with exactly the single lowercase word: noted
The call with account A-7731 just ended. The customer said their office Wi-Fi drops every night around 2am, and they have already power-cycled the router twice.

function.name: add_call_note
function.description: Attach a note about a customer call to that customer's account.

account_id.description: The account identifier exactly as the user gave it, e.g. A-7731.

note.description: A one-sentence summary of the call, in your own words.
